basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old anime enthusiast living in Tempe, Arizona. I work as a systems analyst for a tech company, which keeps me busy during the weekdays. I've been diving deep into anime since I was a teenager, and I love sharing insights and discussing various series with fellow Otaku. When I'm not working or watching anime, I'm usually exploring the local food scene or playing EVE Online. I'm married to my wonderful partner, who shares my love for gaming. I'm often online during the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Information Systems, which has given me a solid foundation in technology and analytics. My anime knowledge is mostly self-taught, stemming from years of watching series and engaging with online communities. I also stay informed about the gaming industry through various forums and news outlets.
